direction: Four variations of Cue and Frame, based on the user's shortlisted names. Awaiting choice before application and GitHub publication.

concepts.name: Cue — loop
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one premium original logo exploration board for a personal video website named exactly "Cue". The user has narrowed their choice to Cue or Frame and wants strong new designs, not a renamed stock icon. This version is CUE LOOP: an elegant open circular C-shaped playback loop with a single crisp right-facing play triangle in its negative space. The opening of the C should subtly imply progressing to the next video. Prioritise simplicity and a clear video connection. Absolutely no animals, birds, mascots or unrelated illustrations. Do not imitate YouTube's rounded rectangle or a familiar streaming-service logo.
Symbol: refined, optically balanced, mostly monoline-to-solid geometry, confident and compact, legible as a favicon at 24px. No extra stripes, no multiple play triangles, no fussy detail. This is a new alternative to the previous Cue mark with queue stripes; do not add queue stripes here.
Wordmark exact spelling "Cue": custom elegant medium-bold rounded sans, beautiful kerning, warm white. The e should be a normal readable e, without another triangle inside it, allowing the symbol to remain the hero.
Palette: coral #FF765E, warm white #F8F3EE, deep charcoal #111316. Strictly flat solid colours, clean vector-style contours. No texture, gradients, glow, shadows or 3D.
Layout: polished landscape brand board 1536x1024. Upper 65% deep charcoal with generous negative space, small upper-left label exactly "CUE / LOOP", and a dominant centered horizontal logo lockup. Lower 35% warm white shows three consistent applications: coral symbol alone, black monochrome horizontal lockup, small charcoal rounded-square app icon with the identical coral symbol. Lots of whitespace and professional editorial alignment. Only text "Cue" and "CUE / LOOP". All symbol reproductions must be identical. Original professional digital product identity, unmistakably about watching video.

concepts.name: Cue — queue
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one original high-end logo exploration board for the exact brand name "Cue", a personal video website that improves channel subscriptions and the watching queue. The user wants an alternative focused on video and organisation. This version is CUE QUEUE: a compact angular monogram where a single right-facing play cutout is built into a geometric C, and two restrained offset short horizontal queue bars form its lower edge. Aim for a brilliant, simple C / cue / next-up symbol with a strong silhouette, visibly different from a circular ring logo. It should be clear at 24px and avoid looking like a letter Q with a long tail.
Wordmark exact spelling "Cue", bespoke contemporary grotesk with slightly squared curves, confident and compact, exceptional spacing. Do not put additional triangles inside the letters. An original identity crafted by an excellent independent design studio.
Palette: luminous amber #FFB020, warm white #F8F4ED, near-black #0D1117. Flat vector-like precision, no gradients, textures, glow, shadows or 3D. No animals, mascots, planets or YouTube red rounded rectangles.
Landscape board 1536x1024. Upper 65% near-black, small upper-left label exactly "CUE / QUEUE", large central horizontal mark + wordmark, spacious clean composition. Lower 35% warm white, three equally spaced usage proofs: amber symbol alone, black monochrome horizontal lockup, small near-black app-icon tile with the same amber mark. Repeat the identical logo faithfully in each usage, no competing variants within the board. Text only "Cue" and "CUE / QUEUE". Elegant, commercially polished brand presentation with the logo as the hero.

concepts.name: Frame — aperture
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create an exceptional new logo concept board for a personal video website named exactly "Frame". The user likes the name and wants a fresh alternative to a generic angular F monogram. This version is FRAME APERTURE: an original compact open viewing window made from two interlocking bracket-like shapes, whose negative space creates one subtle forward-play aperture. It should clearly suggest framing a video and starting playback, with elegant negative space and confident simple geometry. Do not draw just four camera-focus corners, a generic camera, or a standard YouTube play icon. At most three simple shapes; immediately legible at favicon scale.
Wordmark exact spelling "Frame", beautiful custom medium-bold geometric typography with softly rounded corners and precise kerning. The F may have one subtle cut echoing the mark, but all letters should be highly readable.
Palette: sky blue #78B7FF, cool white #F4F7FC, deep navy-black #0B111B. Flat solid colours with clean vector-like edges. No gradients, textures, glow, shadows, bevels or 3D. Absolutely no animals, birds, mascots or planetary imagery.
Layout: landscape professional brand board 1536x1024. Upper 65% deep navy-black with a small upper-left label exactly "FRAME / APERTURE", one dominant centered horizontal logo and generous negative space. Lower 35% cool white shows three spaced faithful applications: sky blue symbol alone, black monochrome horizontal lockup, small navy app-icon tile with the identical blue symbol. No extra diagrams, mockup objects or alternative logos within the board. Only text "Frame" and "FRAME / APERTURE". Memorable, polished, original digital product identity.

concepts.name: Frame — cut
concepts.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create a high-end new logo exploration board for the exact name "Frame", a personal video platform for organised subscriptions and a better player. The user likes Frame and wants more meaningful video-related logo options. This version is FRAME CUT: an original, beautifully simple F monogram integrated into a compact landscape screen silhouette. A single diagonal cut / forward-facing negative-space notch should suggest an editing cut and video playback. Make it more cohesive and sophisticated than a plain block letter F, with precise angles and excellent optical balance. Simple enough to read at 24px. No camera illustration, no generic four-corner focus icon, no YouTube-style red rectangle, no animals or mascots.
Wordmark exact spelling "Frame", premium slightly condensed geometric sans, carefully customised F and r, strong medium-bold weight, impeccable kerning and a clear editorial character. The symbol and wordmark should feel deliberately designed together.
Palette: soft mint #7CE4C4, pale ice #F2F8F5, deep pine-black #0C1717, providing a distinct calm colour alternative to blue. Strictly flat solid-colour vector-style artwork, no gradients, texture, glow, shadows or 3D.
Landscape board 1536x1024. Upper 65% deep pine-black, small upper-left label exactly "FRAME / CUT", a large centered horizontal icon + wordmark and generous negative space. Lower 35% pale ice with three aligned faithful reproductions: mint icon alone, black monochrome horizontal logo, small dark app-icon tile using the identical mint icon. Consistent mark in all applications. Text only "Frame" and "FRAME / CUT". Clean professionally art-directed presentation, original memorable video-product branding.
